claims.text:
stage computation: Two valid1D cross-correlation training windows x1=[1,0], y1=1 and x2=[0,1], y2=−1; no bias. Loss=.5*sum_i(w dot x_i−y_i)², w0=[0,0]. Full-batch gradient=[w0−1,w1+1], eta=.5 gives [.5,−.5] and loss .25 from1. Second step [.75,−.75] gives .0625. Apply updated shared weights to heldout window[1,1], giving0.

**Countercase / boundary:** Flip both labels and restart: learned coefficients become[−.5,.5] at first step, not the original differencer. Tiny supplied examples and squared loss do not demonstrate learned image semantics or a trained production CNN.

**Prediction / transfer recall:** Predict whether the same inputs with reversed labels learn the same filter; recall one more original-label step produces [.875,−.875] and loss .015625.

**Intervention / reachable witness:** Train step recomputes both gradients, coefficients, two outputs and loss. Reverse labels restarts the training state while retaining original trained-filter witness. Show label-driven change, not an author-selected “edge filter” toggle.
